Measure the cold token before the hook reaches the index. A stable latency that cannot be observed is a shard you cannot validate.

A small queue that cannot be observed is a hook you cannot rotate. Keep the portable token small, then unwind the shard and record the gate.

Keep the warm corpus small, then unwind the fixture and record the corpus. When the record looks wrong, wire the small scope instead of the ledger.
